readerCopy.headline: The idea gets bigger, and so does the conversation.
readerCopy.body:
A private idea may suddenly need a proposal, a meeting, or a much longer explanation. You may be writing more, learning quickly, or seeing connections that were difficult to notice before. The larger view can be useful because you finally understand where the idea could go.

Jupiter conjunct Mercury can also make the fine print disappear behind the exciting part. Put the big idea into language another person can actually answer. Then check the date, number, promise, or clause that will still matter after the conversation ends.
